title: Remove duplicate model stepper from examples nav
description: The examples model-compare topbar duplicated model navigation: a prev/next stepper with an N of 6 indicator sat above the same choice already offered by the model pill list and the dropdown below it. Removed the stepper (component, CSS, and the Playwright assertions that pinned it) and kept the pill list plus dropdown as the single navigation control. Change: site/components/ModelCompareNav.tsx, site/app/globals.css, site/tests/acceptance.spec.ts on branch claude/sharp-dirac-6esl2f.
